Docket 1.3.75

**A monitored site's check can now be stopped.**

An audit you start yourself has always had a cancel. A watchlist check did not:
once it began crawling, nothing could stop it — not the app, not quitting it.
Press **Check now** on a site with a large page budget and you were committed to
the whole crawl.

There is now a **Stop check** button on the site's page while that site is being
checked, and quitting Docket interrupts a running check rather than leaving it
to finish.

**A stopped check records nothing, and that is deliberate.** A cancelled crawl
has only read part of the site, so its score is not comparable to a full one.
Storing it would put a fraction-of-the-site result into your trend line and into
the next "what changed" comparison, and the site would appear to have collapsed
overnight. So a stopped check leaves your history exactly as it was and says so.

This is the third capability that existed for an audit you run by hand and was
missing from a scheduled one — after live progress, and after the report each
check now keeps. It was found by going looking for it.
